Checkout help

Orders over fifty dollars ship free within the country.

Delivery takes two to five working days after the order leaves the warehouse, and a tracking link comes by email.

Returns are free for thirty days.

Items must be unused and in their original packaging to be accepted for a refund of the full price.

Gift wrap costs three dollars per item.

Gift messages are printed on a card and placed inside the package, never on the invoice.

Express delivery

Express orders placed before noon arrive the next working day in most cities, and in two days elsewhere.
